bio: This 18C doctor’s home, set in the picturesque village of Herzele and a well-kept secret among discerning foodies, is depicted by a snug interior, a superb terrace and Tamara’s attentive service. Tim Ritserveldt deploys his virtuoso culinary skills, rustling up set menus overflowing in creativity. Hearty, gutsy flavours are his hallmark, such as feta, watermelon sorbet and guacamole cream which enhance the character and depth of thinly sliced Duroc ham. Full-bodied, spot-on food that enjoys straying from conventional culinary paths....
